svg.text: one phase at a time, or so help us

g.text: Run the existing app, exactly as-is, in K3s. No rewrites. No new state layer.
Scale to 2 replicas. Watch the queue break. Add Redis. Scale again. Now it works.
Kill pods. Drain nodes. Watch it recover. Add monitoring so you know when it doesn't.
Phase 4 — second data centre (optional, future-us problem)
By now you'll actually understand what this costs. Then decide if it's worth it.

svg.text: active/active needs app redesign — active/standby with manual failover is probably enough for this workload
